A Note From the Traveller

passenger details

Hello, I'm Sohaib.

I'm an Etsy seller with hands-on experience in shop setup, keyword-rich listings, digital product creation and dependable customer care. Canva is my creative playground, where I design templates, branding and social content that look good and sell well.

I'm currently studying commerce at Hailey College of Commerce, University of the Punjab, blending business thinking with creative design. When I'm not working, you'll find me travelling and heading out on new adventures, which fuel every idea I create.

– Sohaib
